name: Market Type 9 Code
definition: Specifies the type of place where a trade was executed, a price was sourced from, an instrument is listed.

FUND.name: Fund
FUND.definition: The place is a fund (transfer agent, fund itself, etc.).

LMAR.name: Local Market
LMAR.definition: The place is a local market.

SCAS.name: Smart Contract Automated Pricing System
SCAS.definition: Source of price quotation is a smart contract automated pricing system.
